title: A lake of chemicals
text: John Searles discovered borax on the surface of Searles Lake in 1862. Plants at Argus, Trona, and Westend still extract industrial minerals from the lake's brines. The products include borax, boric acid, soda ash, and salt. The dry lake basin is about 12 miles long and about 8 miles wide at its widest point.
